description: Covers B26 (with B31 merged into it), B51, B60. acceptance.py (through ctl.py build_info()) reads the DLL build id after the launch, or refuses the kit-id fallback, so pass 1 on a fresh install counts (B26, B31); ctl.py scene stages a row's named save into the save folder under a harness name and clears it after (B51); find why the hist_nile relaunch sometimes gets no on_virtual within 180 s and retry the launch once inside v_scene, logged (B60).
title: Acceptance and scene launches: build id after launch, staged saves, hist_nile retry
